findings.title: E2E golden path fails deterministically in dev mode (hydration race on auth/register submit)
findings.actual: Test times out at line 40 (page.waitForURL(/\/dashboard.../)) because the button[type='submit'] click on /auth/register fires before Vue @submit.prevent hydrates. The form does a native HTML GET submission, navigating to /en/auth/register?email=...&password=...&confirmPassword=... instead of POSTing JSON to /api/auth/register. Reproduced 5 times in a row (initial run + 2 manual retries + Playwright --retries=2). Same hydration race for both registration form and any other VVee-validate form that uses @submit.prevent. The i18n.spec.ts test passes because it calls page.waitForLoadState('networkidle') before clicking the lang-switcher (which the projects.spec.ts deliberately removed per Task 10 fix-commit e10067d, citing 'HMR-websocket flake source').
findings.reproduction: 1. Start backend: cd backend && ./gradlew bootRun. 2. Start Mongo+Redis+Mailpit (docker-compose up). 3. cd frontend && pnpm exec playwright test e2e/projects.spec.ts. 4. Observe deterministic timeout at /auth/register step. Verifying on production build (pnpm build && pnpm preview) not attempted under this QA pass — JS bundle in prod is materially faster to hydrate and the same race may not appear in CI.
findings.suggestedFix: Re-introduce a hydration gate before the register submit: either (a) await page.waitForLoadState('networkidle') with HMR muted in test env, or (b) await expect(page.locator('html')).toHaveAttribute('data-nuxt-ready', 'true') if a ready marker exists, or (c) wait for a JS-only behavior to be reactive (e.g. fill the email with an invalid value, expect the validation error to render, then re-fill with valid value before submitting). Returns Task 10 to work-loop for E2E spec hardening before merge to a production-like environment.

deferredToPostDeploy.criterion: Локально перед merge: cross-restart localStorage persistence, soft-delete + 404-interceptor cleanup
deferredToPostDeploy.reason: Requires live browser session (Chrome DevTools → Local Storage inspection) with full close/reopen cycle. Covered by unit tests at the store level (tests/stores/projects.spec.ts), but the cross-restart user-level UX behavior is not asserted in any automated test.
deferredToPostDeploy.verificationCondition: User opens the deployed stack manually after merge, creates 2 projects, selects B, closes browser, reopens, verifies selector still shows B; then soft-deletes B and verifies new tab falls back to A.
deferredToPostDeploy.verificationSteps: 1. Register/login at deployed frontend. 2. Create project A and B. 3. Select B in topbar selector. 4. DevTools → Application → Local Storage: verify bot-funnel.currentProjectId === <B-id>. 5. Close browser entirely, reopen, log in: selector shows B. 6. Settings → soft-delete B. 7. Open new tab: selector shows A (404-interceptor cleared localStorage).

deferredToPostDeploy.criterion: AC-28 production-build verification of E2E golden path
deferredToPostDeploy.reason: Failure under dev mode is a hydration timing race that is much less likely to manifest under a production build (bundled, minified JS hydrates faster). Verifying on prod-build is the natural next step before the spec is patched.
deferredToPostDeploy.verificationCondition: Either fix the spec hydration gate (returns Task 10 to work-loop) OR run pnpm build && pnpm preview + pnpm exec playwright test e2e/projects.spec.ts and confirm green.
deferredToPostDeploy.verificationSteps: 1. cd frontend && pnpm build. 2. NUXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE pointed at running backend, pnpm preview & 3. pnpm exec playwright test e2e/projects.spec.ts --reporter=list.
